post.description: Production JSON-RPC 2.0 interface for custodial signing requests. Method 'bitguard_signTransaction' executes the 6-stage policy pipeline (decode -> intent -> delegation -> limits -> enrichment -> decide) under mTLS caller authentication. ALLOW returns the signature; HOLD returns error -32004; DENY returns error -32003.
Issues a signed, short-lived JWT token for any of the 6 seeded roles: Viewer, Operator, SecOps, Compliance, Approver, Admin. Strictly disabled when ENV=production.
